# EML Project Agents

This folder holds the project-specific Copilot/Codex agent definitions used by the active workspace instruction layer.

## Active Agents

| Agent | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `book-drafter.agent.md` | Drafting or revising book chapters across the four-part manuscript. |
| `journal-reading.agent.md` | Processing handwritten notes through the Learning Journal Cycle. |
| `knowledge-space-semiotics.agent.md` | Developing knowledge-space, semiotics, colour grammar, and visual-language material. |
| `mobile-knowledge-intake.agent.md` | Routing mobile captures, ChatGPT returns, and phone-originated fragments into the repo. |
| `read-write-model.agent.md` | Working on inscription, projection, re-entry, revision, and drift control in the Read-Write Model lane. |
| `temporal-casting.agent.md` | Generating Step 0 temporal casting scaffold runs around a dated anchor. |

## Authority

- `.github/copilot-instructions.md` sets the workspace-level operating contract.
- `.github/instructions/` holds reusable rule files.
- `08-Admin/Instructions/agent.md` remains the detailed operating supplement for the project.

Use these agent files for active workflow routing. Keep historical or portable instruction sets in `08-Admin/Instructions/`.
